//: `indexes` is empty because it should be. Every query the application runs
sorts or filters on a single field, and Firestore creates a single-field
A composite index is needed only for a query that combines an equality
filter with an order on a different field, and none of the above does.
Declaring one anyway would cost write throughput on every document for an
index nothing reads. This file exists so `firebase deploy --only
firestore` is complete rather than silently partial.
`fieldOverrides` is empty for the same reason: no field here is large
enough or unqueried enough to be worth exempting from indexing.
